name: K8s Info Agent
description: Comprehensive Kubernetes debugging assistant that can access cluster resources, monitor metrics, analyze logs, and diagnose issues across pods, nodes, deployments, services, storage, and cluster components.

skills.name: Kubernetes Debugging
skills.description: Comprehensive Kubernetes debugging capabilities including pod analysis, node monitoring, deployment troubleshooting, service diagnostics, storage investigation, and cluster-wide health checks.
examples: Debug a pod that's stuck in CrashLoopBackOff
Investigate high CPU usage on worker nodes
Troubleshoot a deployment that's not scaling properly
Diagnose network connectivity issues between services
Check storage capacity and PVC status
Analyze cluster-wide events and component health
Monitor resource usage across the cluster
